Default is "text-embedding-3-small" [base_url]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["https://api.openai.com/v1"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The base URL for the OpenAI API. Default is "https://api.openai.com/v1". [api_key]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The API key for authenticating with OpenAI. If None, it will use the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable if set. [batch_size]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[20]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The number of texts to process in each batch when calling the API. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#11862047 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from raghilda.embedding import EmbeddingOpenAI provider = EmbeddingOpenAI(model="text-embedding-3-small") embeddings = provider.embed(["hello world", "testing embeddings"]) print(len(embeddings)) print(len(embeddings[0])) # Dimension of the embedding print(embeddings[0][:10]) # The embedding vector ``` :::
